about: Qualicum Beach is a town on Vancouver Island’s Oceanside, between Parksville and the Bowser shore, facing the Strait of Georgia—not Parksville, which is a separate town. A wide sand beach, old-growth remnants, and a walkable village centre define this retirement-and-visitor community. About 9,000 people live in Qualicum Beach.
seoSummary: Vancouver Island Oceanside town—sand beach and village centre, not the neighbouring Town of Parksville.
knownFor: Oceanside beach town on the Strait of Georgia
Wide sand beach and waterfront promenade
